source.primary_witnesses: **Greek (Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus) PRESERVES PORTIONS of the SECONDARY ALLOTMENT material of ch 9 (sub-allotments of Shem's, Ham's, Japhet's grandsons).** Where Greek preserves, Greek is a secondary witness. 11Q12 not preserved at this chapter. Ge'ez (Charles 1902 + VanderKam 1989) is primary.
source.transliteration_convention: Hebrew SBL/Sefaria; Greek SBL; Ge'ez SBL.
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Dean 1935 Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus + VanderKam 1989 + VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.fetchedFrom: Dean 1935 Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus; VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511; Charles 1902; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.citation: Dean 1935 Epiphanius De mensuris et ponderibus; VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia; Charles 1902; Alexander 1982 'Notes on the Imago Mundi of the Book of Jubilees'; Scott 2002 Geography in Early Judaism and Christianity.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 9 — **THE SECOND-LEVEL LAND-DIVISION among the grandchildren of Noah (Shem's 5 sons + Ham's 4 sons + Japhet's 7 sons = 16 grandchildren receive sub-allotments) + Noah's final oath binding all the descendants to honor the territorial allotments + cursing of trespass.** Short chapter (~15 verses per VanderKam 1989). Greek Epiphanius preserves the sub-allotment material substantially. **Bidirectional with v2.66.0 Jerusalem-omphalos glossary entry — the territorial allotments establish the WoH-relevant sacred-geography.**

verses.text_geez: ወከፈለ፡ ሐም፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለኩሽ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወምዕራብ፡ ለምሥር፡ ወቅርብት፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ለፉጥ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ወቅርብት፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ለከንዓን፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ባሕር፡
verses.translit: wa-kafala Ḥam la-daqiqu wa-waḍʾa makfalt qadāmāwi la-Kuš mangala məsərāq wa-məʿrāb la-Məsr wa-qərbət lāʿlēhu la-Fuṭ mangala məʿrāb wa-qərbət lāʿlēhu la-Kanʿān mangala məʿrāb bāḥr
verses.notes: **Ham subdivides his territory among his sons: Cush (Ethiopia/southern Africa) east; Mizraim (Egypt) west; Phut (Libya/Maghreb) west; Canaan (Levant) west to sea.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — STANDARD CUSH=ETHIOPIA + MIZRAIM=EGYPT + CANAAN=LEVANT IDENTIFICATIONS.** Note: CANAAN'S ALLOTMENT IS NORTHWEST AFRICA (the Mediterranean coast of north Africa) — NOT the Levant. The Levant is in SHEM'S TERRITORY (cf. 8:21). This is why Canaan's trespass into Levant (7:13) is foundational legal-territorial offense.

verses.text_geez: ወከፈለ፡ ሴም፡ ካዕበ፡ ምድሮ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለኤላም፡ ዘመንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ እምነ፡ ፈለግ፡ ጤግሮስ፡ እስከ፡ ይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ ሕንድ፡ ወውስተ፡ ኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡ ቅሩበ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወውስተ፡ ማየ፡ ዳዲሽ፡ ወይከይድ፡ ኵሎ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ወይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ ኤትዮ፡ ምድር፡ ወመንገለ፡ መካን፡ ዘፋርስ፡ ወቤትሰዐድ፡
verses.translit: wa-kafala Sēm kāʿba mədro la-daqiqu wa-waḍʾa makfalt qadāmāwi la-ʾElām zamangala məsərāq ʾəm-nə falag Ṭēgros ʾəska yəkayyəd mangala məsərāq kwəlu mədra Hənd wa-wəsta ʾErtərā bāḥr qərruba lottu wa-wəsta māya Dādiš wa-yəkayyəd kwəlo mangala saymən wa-yəkayyəd ḫaba yəkayyəd ḫaba ʾEtyo mədr wa-mangala makān zaFārs wa-Bētsaʿd
verses.notes: **Shem subdivides: ELAM east of Tigris through India to Erythrean Sea = Iranian plateau + India.** First Shem-sub-allotment.

verses.text_geez: ወለአሱር፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ካልእ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ አሱር፡ ወነነዌ፡ ወሺንዐራ፡ ወእስከ፡ ኤፍራጥስ፡ ብሔር፡
verses.translit: wa-la-ʾAsur waḍʾa makfalt kāləʾ kwəlu mədra ʾAsur wa-Nanawē wa-Šinʿarā wa-ʾəska ʾEfrāṭs bəḥēr
verses.notes: **Asshur receives Assyria (Nineveh, Shinar = Mesopotamia, to Euphrates).**

verses.text_geez: ወለአርፋክስድ፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ሣልስ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ ብሔረ፡ ከለዳዊያን፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ኤፍራጥስ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ለኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ማያተ፡ ገዳም፡ እስከ፡ ቀርብት፡ ለላዕለ፡ ለማእከለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ባሕር፡ መንገለ፡ ምድረ፡ ሐም፡
verses.translit: wa-la-ʾArfaksəd waḍʾa makfalt śāləs kwəlu mədra bəḥēra Kaladāwiyān mangala məsərāq ʾEfrāṭs qərruba la-ʾErtərā bāḥr wa-kwəlu māyāta gadām ʾəska qərbət la-lāʿla la-māʾkala məsərāq bāḥr mangala mədra Ḥam
verses.notes: **Arpachshad receives CHALDEA — east of Euphrates, to Erythrean Sea. **Foundational placement of Hebrew-line in Chaldea — sets up Abraham's later Ur-of-the-Chaldeans origin (Jub 11:3, 12:15).**

verses.text_geez: ወለአራም፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ራብዕ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ መሶጶታምያ፡ ማእከለ፡ ጤግሮስ፡ ወኤፍራጥስ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ከለዳዊያን፡ እስከ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ ይከይድ፡ ደብር፡ አሱር፡ ወምድር፡ አራራት፡
verses.translit: wa-la-ʾArām waḍʾa makfalt rābəʿ kwəlu mədr Masop̣otāməyā māʾkala Ṭēgros wa-ʾEfrāṭs mangala saymən ʾəm-nə mədr Kaladāwiyān ʾəska yəkayyəd ḫaba yəkayyəd dabr ʾAsur wa-mədr ʾArārāt
verses.notes: **Aram receives MESOPOTAMIA between Tigris and Euphrates north of Chaldea, extending to Ararat region.**

verses.text_geez: ወለሊዶ፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ኃምስ፡ ደብር፡ ኤሳው፡ ወኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ዘያቀርብ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ መንገለ፡ ካሬያ፡ ወመንገለ፡ መካናተ፡ መንገለ፡ ቆስታ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡
verses.translit: wa-la-Liddo waḍʾa makfalt ḫāməs dabr ʾEśāw wa-kwəlu mədr zayāqarrəb lāʿlēhu mangala Kāreyā wa-mangala makānāta mangala Qosətā wa-mangala məʿrāb
verses.notes: **Lud receives mountain-Esau-territory (Asia Minor — Lydia, Caria, Cilicia coast).** Note Esau-territory pre-Esau — Edom-area as ethnonym-prefiguration.

verses.text_geez: ወከፈለ፡ ያፌት፡ ምድሮ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለጎሜር፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ እምነ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ መንገለ፡ ቲና፡ ፈለግ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ይከይድ፡ ለመክፈልቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ዘመጋጎግ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ዘይከይድ፡ ኵሎ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡
verses.translit: wa-kafala Yāfet mədro la-daqiqu wa-waḍʾa makfalt qadāmāwi la-Gomer mangala məsərāq ʾəm-nə mangala saymən mangala Tinā falag wa-mangala saymən yəkayyəd la-makfaltu kwəlu mədr zaMagog mangala məsərāq zayəkayyəd kwəlo mangala məsərāq
verses.notes: **Japhet subdivides: Gomer + Magog get NE Asia / Scythia.** **CROSS-CORPUS — MAGOG**: cf. Ezek 38:2, 39:1 (Gog and Magog); cf. Rev 20:8. The northern eschatological-foes.

verses.text_geez: ወለማዳይ፡ ወፅአ፡ መካን፡ ለመክፈልት፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ለቲና፡ ፈለግ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ለቲና፡ ፈለግ፡
verses.translit: wa-la-Mādāy waḍʾa makān la-makfalt mangala məsərāq la-Tinā falag mangala mədr mangala məʿrāb lāʿlēhu la-Tinā falag
verses.notes: **Madai (Medes) — between Tina river and the Caspian region.**

verses.text_geez: ወለያዋን፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ራብዕ፡ ኵሉ፡ ደሰያት፡ ወደሰያት፡ ቅሩብ፡ ለሊዶ፡
verses.translit: wa-la-Yāwān waḍʾa makfalt rābəʿ kwəlu dasayāt wa-dasayāt qərrub la-Liddo
verses.notes: **JAVAN gets all the ISLANDS — = Greek mainland + Aegean + Mediterranean islands.** Standard Yavan = Ionian/Greek identification. cf. Gen 10:4-5; cf. Isa 66:19.

verses.text_geez: ወለቱባል፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ኃምስ፡ ማእከለ፡ ይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ ቤትፋራማ፡
verses.translit: wa-la-Tubāl waḍʾa makfalt ḫāməs māʾkala yəkayyəd mangala saymən mangala məʿrāb mangala mədr Bētfārāmā
verses.notes: **Tubal — northern Anatolia / Caucasian region.** cf. Ezek 27:13.

verses.text_geez: ወለሞሰሐ፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ሳድስ፡ መንገለ፡ ይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ ቤትፋራማ፡ ወመንገለ፡ ዘይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡
verses.translit: wa-la-Mosaḥ waḍʾa makfalt sādəs mangala yəkayyəd mangala mədr Bētfārāmā wa-mangala zayəkayyəd mangala məʿrāb
verses.notes: **Meshech — adjacent to Tubal-area, west-Anatolian.** Tubal + Meshech = Anatolian-Caucasian cluster.**

verses.text_geez: ወለቲራስ፡ ወፅአ፡ መክፈልት፡ ሳብዕ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ደሰያት፡ ዐበይተ፡ ማእከለ፡ ባሕር፡ ዘይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ ዘሐም፡
verses.translit: wa-la-Tirās waḍʾa makfalt sābəʿ ʾarbāʿtu dasayāt ʿabayta māʾkala bāḥr zayəkayyəd mangala mədr zaḤam
verses.notes: **Tiras — four great Mediterranean islands toward Ham-territory (= Italy/Sicily/Sardinia/Corsica? or Crete/Cyprus/Sicily/Malta?).** Cross-corpus: Tiras = Thracian (Josephus Ant. 1.123) but Jubilees gives island-territory.

verses.text_geez: ወከመዝ፡ ከፈልዎ፡ ለምድር፡ ደቂቁ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ቅድመ፡ ኖኅ፡ አቡሆሙ፡ ወአምሐልዎሙ፡ መሐለ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኪደ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘይተዐደው፡ ዕፆ፡ ዘወፅአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ መሐለ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ መርገመ፡ ለለ፡ ዘይዘምድ፡
verses.translit: wa-kamazə kafalwo la-mədr daqiqu la-Noḫ qədma Noḫ ʾabbuhomu wa-ʾamḥalwomu maḥala kwəlo kida lāʿla kwəlu sabʾ zayətʿaddaw ʿəḍo zawaḍʾa lottu kwəlu maḥala lāʿlēhu margama la-la-zayəzammədə
verses.notes: **Noah's sons swear an OATH not to trespass on one another's allotments — and curse anyone who does so.** **MAJOR — THE TERRITORIAL-OATH IS THE FOUNDATIONAL DIVISION-DOCTRINE.** Sets up Canaan's offense (7:13) as oath-breaking + Jubilees-justification for conquest. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Acts 17:26.

verses.text_geez: ወይቤልዎ፡ አሜን፡ አሜን፡ ሎቱ፡ ወለደቂቁ፡ ለዓለም፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ በዕለታት፡ ኩናኔ፡ ከመ፡ ይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይተዐደው፡ ዕፆ፡ ዘወፅአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ወላዕለ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ለዓለም፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbēləwo ʾāmēn ʾāmēn lottu wa-la-daqiqu la-ʿālam lāʿlēhomu ba-ʿəlatāt kwənnānē kama yətgabbar lāʿla kwəlu zayətʿaddaw ʿəḍo zawaḍʾa lottu lāʿla kiyāhu wa-lāʿla daqiqu la-ʿālam
verses.notes: **'AMEN, AMEN' — the sons accept the oath. Perpetual curse on trespassers.** The Amen-amen formalization.

verses.text_geez: ወባረኮሙ፡ ኖኅ፡ አምላከ፡ ሰማይ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ወባረከ፡ ለእግዚእ፡ ዘፈለጠ፡ ለሎሙ፡ ዕፆሙ፡ ወአቀመ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ምስለ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለዓለም፡
verses.translit: wa-bārakomu Noḫ ʾamlāka samāy lāʿla kwəlomu daqiqu wa-bāraka la-ʾəgziʾ zafalaṭa la-lomu ʿəḍomu wa-ʾaqama kidāna məsla kiyāhomu la-ʿālam
verses.notes: **Noah blesses his sons + praises God who divided allotments + established covenant.** Closes the territorial-allotment narrative; transitions to chapter 10 (Mastema + Babel).
